label: live_monitoring_06_table_missing
description: The shape the Kusto query endpoint answered LIVE (reported by the orchestrator's check against a stand-in Eventhouse, as the Viewer-only reader) when the SemanticModelLogs table does not exist: HTTP 400 whose error.message is generic ('Request is invalid and cannot be executed.') and whose cause, the table name, is only in error['@message']. The earlier paraphrase (doc_monitoring_06_table_missing) put the table in error.message, which is why a match on the message alone never fired. Ids and hosts are synthetic. It is a stand-in database, not a real workspace monitoring database, which has not been observed yet.

error.message: Request is invalid and cannot be executed.
error.@message: Semantic error: 'take' operator: Failed to resolve table or column expression named 'SemanticModelLogs'
